body: Earth is a rocky planet with surface oceans and an atmosphere. Below the crust and mostly solid mantle lie a liquid outer core and a solid inner core.

As Earth rotates, most locations periodically move through light and shadow. Earth's rotational axis is tilted relative to the perpendicular to its orbital plane. As the planet travels around the Sun, each hemisphere receives different amounts of sunlight at different times of year.
